verdict.rationale: Keycloak exposes an Admin REST API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but the evidence only references human-facing 'Documentation for the Administration RESTful API' and never says an OpenAPI or equivalent file is published. The OIDC well-known discovery document is protocol metadata listing auth endpoints, not an API spec, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on keycloak.org all returned 404.
